UserPromptSubmit.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$payload = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($payload)) { $root = Get-Location; $logDir = Join-Path $root 'GymApp/.github/hooks'; if (-not (Test-Path -Path $logDir)) { $logDir = Join-Path $root '.github/hooks' }; if (-not (Test-Path -Path $logDir)) { New-Item -Path $logDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null }; $logPath = Join-Path $logDir 'agent_log.txt'; Add-Content -Path $logPath -Value $payload -Encoding UTF8 }"

PreToolUse.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$payload = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($payload)) { $root = Get-Location; $logDir = Join-Path $root 'GymApp/.github/hooks'; if (-not (Test-Path -Path $logDir)) { $logDir = Join-Path $root '.github/hooks' }; if (-not (Test-Path -Path $logDir)) { New-Item -Path $logDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null }; $logPath = Join-Path $logDir 'agent_log.txt'; Add-Content -Path $logPath -Value $payload -Encoding UTF8 }"
